member.name: M:Lumio.GameRuntime.Persistence.SectionPartitionCheckpoint.VerifyForRestore(Lumio.GameRuntime.Persistence.SectionPartitionCheckpointPayload@,System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyDictionary{System.UInt64,System.UInt64})
member.summary: Verifies one candidate record against the world checkpoint's registered (Section key, generation) and recomputes both digests. A registered record that is missing or whose digest does not match is a fatal error (ADR-119 决策 8); an unregistered, newer record is discarded, not an error.

Selects the durable records a recovery pass must use: exactly the registered (Section key, generation) pairs, each present with a matching digest. Unregistered newer candidates for the same Section key are silently discarded (ADR-119 决策 8), never returned.

member.name: T:Lumio.GameRuntime.Persistence.SectionResidencyRegistry
member.summary: The world checkpoint's registered Section partition records (ADR-119 决策 8): Section key → residency generation. This is a same-cut sidecar to the ECS checkpoint (which already carries the entity half's PartitionRegistration through WorldSnapshotCodec); the registry adds the one fact that codec has no field for — which generation of each Section's durable record the checkpoint depends on. A checkpoint taken while no generation is registered for a Section key means that Section's records, however many exist in durable storage, are not depended on by this checkpoint and must not be used to restore it.
